name: Ffmpeg
tagline: This container needs special attention. Please check https://hub. Docker. Com/r/linuxserver/ffmpeg for details.
description: This container needs special attention. Please check https://hub.docker.com/r/linuxserver/ffmpeg for details.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/ffmpeg:9.0.2@sha256:6547359fac23a2747e606d380e10267b2923a38f68485d9cacefd039e74d3aa8
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 80
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
